thread:
Eleanor: hi all, Eleanor here (platform). quick ask: for my first 48h can someone list the single person or channel for: badge/door, short-term VPN, dev GCP project, production service-account reviews, model-serving runbook, and who to page for a Dedicated customer outage? trying to avoid chasing multiple people.

ops-bot: welcome @Eleanor :sparkles: New hire hub: https://redwood.internal/new-hires. Use the access form for perms: https://redwood.internal/forms/access-request.

Devon: welcome! Short answers: badge -> facilities (email facilities@redwood.com, cc people-ops), short VPN for 72h -> `#eng-infra` on the access form with expiry set, dev GCP -> eng-infra (I triage), prod service-account reviews -> `#eng-sre` (tag @Mateo).

Mateo: confirm I handle prod service-account reviews. For emergency prod access changes tag `@eng-sre-oncall` and add "urgent-prod-access" in the subject. We'll ask for a short justification.

Kaya: model-serving runbook is owned by eng-runtime: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-serving.md. For a Dedicated outage start `#support-escalations` and ping `@support-oncall` + `@dedicated-ops` if you know the pool id.

Eleanor: thanks — any tiny escalation flow so I don't post everywhere during a page?

Devon: one-line ladder we use: Serving/runtime issues -> `#eng-runtime` then `@eng-runtime-oncall`. Infra/perm/provisioning -> `#eng-infra` then `@eng-infra-oncall`. Customer impact/Dedicated SLA -> `#support-escalations` then `@support-oncall`. Security incidents -> `#eng-security`. If more than one team, start in `#incident-coord`.

Eleanor: perfect. last: who handles expedited badge if I need floor access same day?

facilities: Facilities received request for Eleanor. If People Ops marks "same-day" we can approve; email people-ops@redwood.com with subject "same-day badge". Ticket #FAC-7890.

Eleanor: amazing — saved me a lot of time. i'll start the form and DM if anything blocks. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
